equip_instructions: Find the track by title; read its uses[] entries. Pick the use_type you need (stream, vod, clips, ad, sync-game, derivative, reupload).
Read the verdict: 'clear' means use it now with attribution. 'conditional' means contact hp@cumulativeweb.com for terms before you ship. 'denied' means do not use for that purpose.
Cache the file. It is static and pre-signed — reason over it offline; refetch only to check for a newer 'updated' date.

item.description: The Business Affairs department's rights-clearance oracle — product #12 of the Agent Deck gear line. Any agent asks 'can I use this track for X?' and gets a machine-readable verdict — clear, conditional, or denied — with terms, territory, and contact, in one fetch. No login, no licensing portal, no per-call cost. Ships the real 24-track That Boy Hi Hat catalog as the cwi-allclear/v1 seed dataset; CWI's pre-cleared positioning made machine-readable.
item.name: THE ALL-CLEAR
